title: Casa Gilardi
notes: San Miguel Chapultepec; the yellow corridor and indoor pool
address: Gral. Antonio León 82, San Miguel Chapultepec, Mexico City

detail.intro: The house for Francisco Gilardi in San Miguel Chapultepec, built around a jacaranda tree that Barragán insisted on keeping. A corridor of yellow light leads to a dining room where a blue and red wall stands in a pool of water. His last completed house before Casa Meyer.
